findings.issue: API boundary is untyped ('api<T = any>'), and callers cast with 'any' throughout (data.ts:49, pokemon.tsx:77, details.tsx:107), so typos in field names fail only at runtime
findings.suggestion: Define minimal interfaces for the PokeAPI resources actually consumed (species, pokemon, move, ability, type, generation) and use them as the api<T> default at each call site

findings.issue: Move-table sort header buttons issue hx-get requests with no hx-sync, so clicks on two different columns can race and the last-resolved response wins
findings.suggestion: Add hx-sync="closest form:replace" or a shared sync group on the table so only the newest sort request lands

findings.issue: onError returns the full page layout regardless of htmx context, so an API failure during a partial request swaps a whole document into #results
findings.suggestion: Return a small error fragment when HX-Request is true (optionally with HX-Retarget), or set no-store on error responses

findings.issue: In-memory cache Map is unbounded and never evicts, only re-validates after 30s
findings.suggestion: Acceptable at this data size, but add a size cap or a comment documenting the expected growth ceiling so future maintainers know it's deliberate

findings.issue: apiUrl falls back to using the raw URL as an API path when it lacks '/api/v2/', silently constructing a wrong request
findings.suggestion: Throw or log on the -1 case; PokeAPI references always contain the prefix, so a fallback path only hides bugs

findings.issue: hx-sync on the input and both selects is redundant with the form-level hx-sync at home.tsx:82
findings.suggestion: Keep one sync definition (the form's) to avoid two sources of truth for request cancellation

findings.issue: Vary: HX-Request... is set only on '/', and no route sets Cache-Control; a reverse proxy in front has no caching contract for the fragment-serving endpoints
findings.suggestion: Set explicit Cache-Control (e.g. no-store for HTML, immutable for /static) consistently across routes

findings.issue: /pokemon/:name/moves and /moves-table return bare fragments on direct navigation — fine as internal htmx endpoints but undocumented
findings.suggestion: Add a one-line comment marking these as htmx fragment endpoints, or gate them to HX-Request requests

summary: A well-layered, genuinely idiomatic Hono+htmx app on current stable versions, with correct htmx partial/history handling and a clean api→data→views structure. The main asks are typing the PokeAPI boundary, a couple of request-race and error-response edge cases the tests wouldn't catch, and small hygiene nits. I'd merge after one round of changes.
